pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:0.6: ime kho panayyāyo chasaṭṭhisatā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena bhikkhunisaṅgho lasunena pavārito hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.3: yāsaṃ ayyānaṃ lasunena attho ahaṃ lasunenāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.5: sace hi bhikkhuniyo āgacchanti. ekekāya bhikkhuniyā dve tayo bhaṇḍike dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.6: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ ussavo hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.13: thullanandā bhikkhunī khettaṃ gantvā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.15: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasunaṃ harāpessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.16: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa khettapālassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.17: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.18: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasunaṃ harāpessatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.19: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasunaṃ harāpesīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.22: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpessati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.25.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa pajāpati ahosi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.28: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo kālaṃ katvā aññataraṃ haṃsayoniṃ upapajji.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.31: atha kho bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī ayaṃ haṃso amhākaṃ ekekaṃ pattaṃ detīti taṃ haṃsarājaṃ gahetvā nippattaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.32: tassa puna jāyamānā pattā setā sampajjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.33: tadāpi bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī atilobhena suvaṇṇā parihīnā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.39: atha kho bhagavā thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubharatāya …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.40: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
